findings.smallestRepair: Ensure cancellation confirmation appears in the visible Assistant body without scrolling, e.g. suppress welcome while this completion notice exists or move notice ahead of welcome. Retain composer focus/text and cancellation generation/abort safety.
findings.recapture: Capture actual request→Cancel→visible cancellation/unchanged-scene message, retained composer and Engineering mode, then full delayed-reply waiting interval with one dispatch/no proposal and unchanged saved data. Preserve this packet.

Proposed scene then visibly places a small parchment note on rear/window table; Locate/View canvas/Frame selection expose actual paper and selection outline. Before Apply, Inspector correctly says proposed object requires review/apply before saved-property editing. Preview does not save the second entity.

After explicit Apply, 'Your changes are saved' is separate from named 'Folded window note: rendered in the current view.' Graph contains Desk Map plus selected Folded window note, canvas outline and Inspector name/message agree. Guided shows identity and grouped controls; Detailed expands Transform; Engineering adds actual coordinate frame/anchor/position. Renderer restored note ID synthetic-window-note is IN_VIEW at[0,0.76,-0.8] with0.22m width and horizontal rotation. Original Desk Map remains unchanged.

Reload chooses Desk Map as selected object rather than persisting note selection. Canonical saved draft equality and post-reload renderer receipt substantiate geometry restoration; exact selected-object focus/camera preservation on reload is not claimed.
